interpretation_note.title: Interpretation Note
interpretation_note.default: Fields are extracted verbatim from the cited documentation; `family` is a platform normalisation, not a source statement.

source_ids.title: Source Ids
source_ids.description: Omit to crawl all active sources

rebuild.title: Rebuild
rebuild.description: Queue a knowledge-base build after the crawl jobs

DuplicateDecision.title: DuplicateDecision
DuplicateDecision.description: Administrator decision on a possible-duplicate item: merge every listed system into canonical_key, or keep them distinct.

IntakeRequest.title: IntakeRequest
IntakeRequest.description:
Attach a URL to an existing system (system_id) or create a separate system (new_system).
Creating a new system while likely duplicates exist requires separate_from = the candidate ids the administrator rejected.

facets.title: Facets
facets.description: Per-type hit counts (search only); `_match_mode: any` when the any-term fallback was used

ResourceLink.title: ResourceLink

SystemUpdate.title: SystemUpdate
SystemUpdate.description: Administrator edits of descriptive fields. Stored as audited curation, so they survive every rebuild.
